column1: # Words that name a unit inside a building and are followed by its number or letter. Columns: countries (comma separated), word (upper case, no accents, periods dropped).

# English words of the United Kingdom, Ireland, Malta and the Crown dependencies; Italian words of Italy, San Marino and the Vatican (UPU Italy sheet: INTERNO, PIANO); the Catalan and Spanish words of Andorra (UPU Andorra sheet: Apartament, Entrada).
# Polish flat and premises words (Poczta Polska, Zasady poprawnego adresowania, 1.2: the building number and, after it, the flat or premises): m. (mieszkanie), lok. (lokal).

# Group B, forms of web pages: Spanish premises words that follow an industrial-estate or street line (nave, parcela, local, oficina), and Portuguese lot and shop words (CTT, Manual de Endereçamento 2014: the door identification may be a "lote, torre ou outro"; its Anexo I lists Lote LT and Loja LJ).
